record.question: Grants to the Autonomous Tribal Areas are provided by the:
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation:
Article 275(1) provides Union grants-in-aid to the revenues of States needing assistance. Its first proviso covers approved projects for Scheduled Tribe welfare and Scheduled Area administration; the following provisos address tribal areas in Assam, and clause (1A) covers an autonomous State under Article 244A. The question’s “Autonomous Tribal Areas” phrasing is broad, but the Constitution places these grant provisions in Article 275(1), matching the stored key.

Reference: https://www.legislative.gov.in/static/uploads/2025/08/cb1b190ea633a1746368ed1fac35fb30.pdf
